brief.text: A machine shop with one production line of 27 machines that makes 60 machined aluminium bike-light housings an hour, laid out as in the attached sketch on a 36 by 24 metre floor. Aluminium bar stock arrives at the west dock, is checked in at a receiving desk and stored on pallet racks, cut to length on a metal-cutting bandsaw, turned on CNC lathes (about 4 minutes a part), milled on CNC milling machines (about 9 minutes a part), tumbled in vibratory deburring machines, cleaned in a parts washer, measured on coordinate measuring machines, serial-numbered on a fibre laser marking machine, then packed and palletised for shipping at the east dock. Parts move between steps on conveyors.

requirements.name: Bike-Light Housing Machine Shop
requirements.summary: A 27-machine production line machining, finishing, inspecting, and packing 60 aluminium bike-light housings per hour on a 36 by 24 metre floor.
assumptions: Assumed 1 operator per station across all steps since staffing levels were not specified.
Assumed water supply is required for the vibratory deburring machines and the aqueous parts washer.
Assumed separate cycle times for receiving (60 s), pallet rack storage (20 s), and shipping staging (30 s) based on standard handling times.

research.summary:
WORKING NOTES: BIKE-LIGHT HOUSING MACHINE SHOP

1. DEPARTMENTS (IN MATERIAL FLOW ORDER)
Receiving & Storage -> Sawing -> Turning -> Milling -> Finishing & Cleaning -> Inspection & Marking -> Packing & Shipping.

2. PROCESS STEPS, EQUIPMENT, CYCLE TIME, FOOTPRINT & POWER
- Receiving & Storage (West Dock): Check in aluminium bar stock at receiving desk; store on pallet racks. Cycle time: 60 s/unit (estimate). Footprint: 2.5 x 1.2 m per bay (estimate). Power: 0.2 kW (estimate).
- Sawing: Cut bar stock to length on 1 metal-cutting bandsaw. Cycle time: 30 s/unit (estimate). Footprint: 1.5 x 1.5 m. Power: 2.2 kW.
- Turning: Turn housing blanks on 5 CNC lathes. Cycle time: 240 s/unit (4 min/part). Footprint: 2.2 x 1.2 m per lathe. Power: 7.5 kW per lathe.
- Milling: Mill housing features on 11 CNC vertical machining centers (VMCs). Cycle time: 540 s/unit (9 min/part). Footprint: 2.2 x 2.3 m per mill. Power: 18.5 kW per mill.
- Finishing & Cleaning:
  1) Deburr in 2 vibratory deburring bowls. Cycle time: 120 s/unit batch-amortized (estimate). Footprint: 1.2 x 1.2 m each (estimate). Power: 1.5 kW each.
  2) Clean in 1 aqueous parts washer. Cycle time: 60 s/unit (estimate). Footprint: 1.5 x 1.2 m (estimate). Power: 13.5 kW.
- Inspection & Marking:
  1) Measure dimensions on 2 coordinate measuring machines (CMMs). Cycle time: 90 s/unit (estimate). Footprint: 2.0 x 1.5 m each. Power: 0.5 kW each.
  2) Serial-number on 1 fibre laser marking machine. Cycle time: 15 s/unit (estimate). Footprint: 1.2 x 1.2 m (1.5 m²). Power: 2.0 kW.
- Packing & Shipping (East Dock): Pack and palletise at packing bench, stage for east dock shipping. Cycle time: 45 s/unit (estimate). Footprint: 2.0 x 1.5 m per station (estimate). Power: 0.2 kW (estimate).

3. MATERIAL MOVEMENT
Parts move between sawing, turning, milling, finishing, inspection, marking, and packing on powered roller and belt conveyors. Forklifts or pallet jacks handle incoming bar stock and outgoing pallets at the docks (estimate).

4. TYPICAL OUTPUT & FLOOR AREA
- Output: 60 machined aluminium bike-light housings per hour.
- Floor area: 864 m² (36 m x 24 m).
